verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a first-party migration path from Jira, a Trello import, and CSV import for other tools. Its API also tracks external IDs for imported entities, which directly supports switching over from another tool. missing for 10: detailed import docs (which fields, history, attachments and users carry over), independent or hands-on corroboration of migration quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over

citations.quote: Direct migration path from Jira, plus Trello import and CSV for other tools.
In the case that the Category has been imported from another tool, the ID in the other tool can be indicated here.
